title: wkchat window geometry: save on change + exit + restore on init + shortcut update
desc: wkchat must restore terminal window to last-used position/size on startup, save geometry on every move/resize and on exit, and optionally write geometry back into the .lnk shortcut that launched wkappbot.
steps: [REQUIREMENTS] (1) Restore on init: ChatCommand entry -> LoadParentWindowGeo + SetWindowPos before shell. (2) Save on change: SetWinEventHook(EVENT_SYSTEM_MOVESIZEEND) on parent WT HWND -> immediate debounced SaveParentWindowGeo. (3) Save on exit: AppDomain.ProcessExit + Console.CancelKeyPress handler -> SaveParentWindowGeo. (4) Shortcut update (bonus): after save, find the .lnk that launched wkappbot-core.exe via IShellLink COM and write geometry into StartupInfo.

[EXISTING INFRA] SaveConsoleGeo/LoadConsoleGeo/SaveParentWindowGeo/LoadParentWindowGeo all exist in AppBotEyeCommands.cs:264-370. Eye saves parent geo every 30s (AppBotEyeGlobalMode.cs:1788). Missing: chat init restore, on-change hook (replace 30s poll), exit handler, shortcut write.

[IMPL PLAN] (1) ChatCommand.cs:22 add TryRestoreTerminalGeometry(LoadParentWindowGeo + SetWindowPos). (2) AppBotEyeGlobalMode.cs: add SetWinEventHook(EVENT_SYSTEM_MOVESIZEEND=0x800B) callback -> SaveParentWindowGeo, keep 30s poll as fallback. (3) Register exit handler at ChatCommand startup. (4) DPI: mirror AppBotEyeCommands.cs:317 ScreenCoords.LogicalToPhysical on restore.

[SHORTCUT UPDATE] IShellLink COM (Shell32): find .lnk targeting wkappbot-core.exe via Desktop+StartMenu search. Read IShellLink, cast to IShellLinkW, update window style to SW_SHOWNORMAL, IPersistFile.Save. Note: .lnk does not store arbitrary window rect -- store in separate geo JSON instead.

[DPI MANDATORY] Any code touching SetWindowPos/GetWindowRect/ScreenCoords/LogicalToPhysical MUST be implemented by Opus agent per CLAUDE.md DPI rule. Dispatch: Agent(model:'opus', prompt:'Implement TryRestoreTerminalGeometry in ChatCommand.cs using LoadParentWindowGeo + ScreenCoords.LogicalToPhysical + SetWindowPos, mirroring save side at AppBotEyeCommands.cs:317. Add EVENT_SYSTEM_MOVESIZEEND hook in AppBotEyeGlobalMode.cs to replace 30s poll save. Add ProcessExit+CancelKeyPress handler.').

requirements.expect: console_geometry or parent_window_geo present in runtime/
